title: ScatteringKernels: gas-surface scattering kernels for molecular dynamics and DSMC

creators.name: Chen, Yichong
creators.affiliation: Institute of Mechanics, Chinese Academy of Sciences

description:
Tools for simulating, calibrating and applying gas-surface scattering kernels.

The molecular dynamics side prepares rough, layered and physisorbing walls, runs LAMMPS scattering simulations and post-processes the trajectories into accommodation coefficients and kernel statistics. The DSMC side provides three surf_collide styles for SPARTA that take the reflection law from molecular dynamics rather than from a fixed accommodation coefficient: cll/md, with the coefficients resolved in incident energy and angle, cll/md/trap, which adds an explicit trapping branch, and dvsm/md, which resamples the scattering events directly. Also included are the Ar-Pt coefficient and trapping tables, the resampling event library, the two-dimensional cylinder and flat-plate input decks with their case generator and post-processing, and the LAMMPS molecular beam runs that produced the tables.
